Package com.smartlostfound.view

Class UIUtils

java.lang.Object
com.smartlostfound.view.UIUtils
public final class UIUtils extends Object
Executive Design System & UI Utilities. Implements the DesignRush "Best Designs" award-winning aesthetic: high-contrast carbon obsidian (#0B0B0C - #16171A), vibrant signature crimson (#E52E2D), pure white elevated surfaces (#FFFFFF), multi-layered ambient shadows, and high-definition typography with sub-pixel antialiasing.
